newsitem.title: UK: Siebe gains after upbeat agm statement.
newsitem.headline: Siebe gains after upbeat agm statement.

text.p: Shares in Siebe Plc traded 12p higher at 1,010-1/2p, after a confident statement on current trading at the group's annual shareholders' meeting.
The stock was about 9p higher ahead of the meeting.
"They've gone up an extra three pence on the back of the statement," said a market-maker.
Siebe said UK business was buoyant and that its European operations were showing improved signs of business activity.

The company also said Colin Marshall, current chairman of British Airways Plc, would replace its retiring chairman. BA was 1-1/2 pence weaker at 633-1/2. Market makers said the appointment had no impact on the shares.
